SELECT s.id, st.name AS studentName, st.student_no AS studentNo, c.name AS className, su.name AS subjectName, sem.name AS semesterName, e.exam_date AS examDate, e.exam_time AS examTime, s.score FROM score s JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id JOIN class c ON st.class_id = c.id JOIN exam e ON s.exam_id = e.id JOIN subject su ON e.subject_id = su.id JOIN semester sem ON e.semester_id = sem.id
AND c.id = #{dto.classId} AND su.id = #{dto.subjectId} AND sem.id = #{dto.semesterId}
AND (st.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%') OR st.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{dto.keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY s.id

select s.id as id, concat(st.name, ' · ', sub.name, ' · ', e.exam_date, ' · ', s.score) as label from score s join student st on s.student_id = st.id join exam e on s.exam_id = e.id join subject sub on e.subject_id = sub.id order by s.id
